checks.name: Solver finished without errors
checks.meaning: A crash or floating-point exception usually means the solution blew up or a setting is invalid.

checks.name: No NaN values
checks.meaning: NaN (not a number) means the calculation produced invalid values.

checks.name: Max Courant number
checks.meaning: Fluid should not cross more than about one cell per time step (limit used: 0.5). rhoCentralFoam prints its own Courant number: in subsonic flow it is half the usual (|u| + c) dt / dx, in supersonic flow |u| dt / dx without the speed of sound (its source, centralCourantNo.H). A limit copied from its tutorials (maxCo 0.2) is a usual Courant number of about 0.4, where case 18 found the solution ringing behind the shock.

checks.name: Courant number trend
checks.meaning: A steadily growing Courant number is the typical signature of a blow-up.

checks.name: Density, pressure and temperature stay positive
checks.value: lowest density \(0.7917\,\mathrm{kg/m^3}\), pressure \(100.0\,\mathrm{kPa}\), temperature \(300.0\,\mathrm{K}\) at the written times
checks.meaning: The gas expands strongly round the corner. A scheme that overshoots there produces a negative density or pressure, which is not a gas.

checks.name: Cells are in rows and columns as the analysis assumes
checks.meaning: The analysis places cell number i + N j at ((i + 1/2) h, (j + 1/2) h). OpenFOAM's own cell centres must agree.

checks.name: Start state as given
checks.meaning: The solver forms the density from pressure, temperature and its own gas constant. A cell that no wave has reached must hold the given density.

checks.name: Totals recorded after every step
checks.meaning: Mass and energy of the chamber and the mass flow through the opening are needed after every step for the conservation check.

checks.name: The opening delivers the exact mass flow
checks.value: largest relative difference from \(\rho_2 u_2 (H - H_s)\): \(6.7 \times 10^{-16}\)
checks.meaning: The air enters faster than sound, so the face flux at the opening must be the flux of the state behind the shock, from the first step on.

checks.name: Mass and energy equal the start plus the exact inflow, after every step
checks.value: mass \(4.3 \times 10^{-11}\), energy \(4.3 \times 10^{-14}\) of the inflow so far
checks.meaning: The physical check of every step: the walls let nothing through, so the chamber's mass and energy may change only by what the duct brings in.

checks.name: The solver's own Courant number, against the usual one
checks.value: largest printed \(0.232\); in the uniform state behind the shock it is \(0.162\); the usual Courant number along \(x\) there is \(0.200\)
checks.meaning: rhoCentralFoam prints its own measure: half the sum over a cell's faces of the larger one-sided flux speed. In two dimensions it adds both directions, so it can be above the usual number along one direction; the largest value is found where the gas turns round the corner.
